messages:
marie: Heads up — opening a docs PR to migrate console dashboard cost breakdown examples to the new `trace_key_source` param. Need quick ownership + anchor/link fixes before merge. PR: #4821

aj: Thanks — can you paste the snippet here? want to sanity-check the SDK/example config.

marie: Sure, pasted the snippet from the PR branch:

```yaml
dashboard: 
  widgets:
    - type: cost_breakdown
      title: Cost vs Latency
      params:
        trace_key_source: 'billing'  # new param
        sample_rate: 1
        show_latency: true
```

ryan: Is this backward-compatible? customers using `tracehook_id` will need a fallback. we should add a short migration paragraph and a compatibility note.

sophia: I can own the doc updates + link fixes. i'll add a compat section and deprecation timeline. tagging @marie for final snippet wording.

docs-bot: PR opened: #4821 — running docs-lint + link-checker.

aj: minor nit: in the example, change `sample_rate: 1` to `sample_rate: 0.1` so the snippet doesn't suggest a 100% sampling example (expensive).

marie: good call, updated the branch with that change and a changelog bullet.

tom: cc @ryan — do we want a compatibility smoke test? simple: render the example dashboard using both `trace_key_source` and `tracehook_id` and ensure the cost widget falls back gracefully.

ryan: i'll add a small unit in the SDK snippet tests to assert fallback behavior. ETA EOD.

sophia: Link sweep note: i found 3 references to the old param name across docs (quickstart, migration guide, API ref). i'll open PRs for anchor fixes and redirect meta for the docs site.

aj: :thumbsup: sounds good. merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT? assuming deploy-bot + link-check green.

deploy-bot: docs-lint: passed. link-checker: 2 broken anchors found (quickstart anchors).

marie: sophia can you take the anchor fixes? i'll wait for link-check to pass before merging.

sophia: on it. i'll add redirect meta for the old anchors to avoid 404s and update the cross-links.

marie: last ask — please update the console screenshot in the docs to show cost + latency split. I can swap the PNG in the PR if someone uploads the dashboard preview.

tom: i'll run the smoke test and upload a small PNG to the PR after verification. ping me when tests finish.

marie: thanks all — will hold merge until (1) link-check green, (2) SDK snippet test added, (3) screenshot uploaded. planning to merge after the 10:00 PT window if all clear.
